label: lehome-rollout-builder
on-start: apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git docker.io pigz python3-pip && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* ; (service docker start 2>/dev/null || true); if ! docker info >/dev/null 2>&1; then (dockerd >>/var/log/dockerd.log 2>&1 &); fi; for i in $(seq 1 90); do docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 2; done; docker info >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'dockerd failed to start' >&2; exit 1; }; git clone --depth 1 --branch ${BUILD_BRANCH:-ryanjin333/vast-template-sync} https://github.com/ryanjin333/lehome-challenge.git /tmp/src && cd /tmp/src/docker/rollout && IMAGE_TAG=${IMAGE_TAG:-ghcr.io/ryanjin333/lehome-rollout:latest} PUSH=1 REGISTRY_HOST=${REGISTRY_HOST:-ghcr.io} REGISTRY_USER=${REGISTRY_USER:-ryanjin333} REGISTRY_TOKEN=${REGISTRY_TOKEN} ./build.sh 2>&1 | tee /var/log/image-build.log && echo 'BUILD_DONE: image build and push finished' || echo 'BUILD_FAILED: image build or push failed'; if docker image inspect ${IMAGE_TAG:-ghcr.io/ryanjin333/lehome-rollout:latest} >/dev/null 2>&1; then docker save ${IMAGE_TAG:-ghcr.io/ryanjin333/lehome-rollout:latest} | pigz -p 8 > /workspace/lehome-rollout.tar.gz && pip3 install -q 'huggingface_hub[cli,hf_transfer]' && HF_HUB_ENABLE_HF_TRANSFER=1 HF_TOKEN=${HF_TOKEN} hf upload --repo-type dataset ryanjin333/lehome-rollout-image /workspace/lehome-rollout.tar.gz lehome-rollout.tar.gz && echo 'HF_UPLOAD_DONE: tarball uploaded to HF' || echo 'HF_UPLOAD_FAILED'; fi
